summary: Real-code evidence for the Sermon Harvest one-click aggregation bundle: the first of five pillars identified in the gap analysis against the project's original master specification document.
trigger: The user shared the project's original master architecture document plus example videos and asked to continue building out the remaining vision, explicitly authorizing all five identified gaps: multi-screen presentation output, semantic/paraphrase Bible detection, Sermon Harvest, real audio fingerprinting, and multi-language support (the latter confirmed as a near-term priority). The user also confirmed keeping Sermon Intelligence strict/evidence-only rather than adopting the document's LLM-based generative AI Summary/Reflection framing.
whySequencedFirst: Sermon Harvest required zero new dependencies, zero new detection logic, and zero new AI - it only assembles data this application already captures through five separately-tested pipelines (sermon foundation sections, Sermon Intelligence findings, Bible suggestions, transcript, timeline) into one response. This kept the first phase of a five-pillar scope small, reviewable, and consistent with this project's one-phase-at-a-time discipline.

auditedBeforeImplementing.sermonIdLinkage: IntelligenceFinding already carries a sermon_id: Option<Uuid> field (added Phase 2.6), confirmed by reading core/intelligence's finding.rs directly rather than assuming.
auditedBeforeImplementing.findingQueuePersistence: FindingQueue is in-memory only, never persisted to SQLite - a deliberate Phase 2.0 design already documented in docs/phase-3-8-7-6-live-intelligence-integration-audit.md. This is the one real scope boundary this phase surfaces honestly: Harvest only ever works for the currently active sermon, same app session.
auditedBeforeImplementing.existingReadFunctions: persistence::list_sermon_sections, persistence::list_suggestions, persistence::list_transcript_segments (bounded), timeline::list_timeline (bounded) all already existed and needed no changes - confirmed via grep before writing harvest.rs, not assumed.
auditedBeforeImplementing.elementKindTaxonomy: SermonElementKind (19 kinds: MainPoint/SubPoint/PrayerPoint/FoodForThought/Takeaway/Question/etc.) is embedded only as a text prefix in IntelligenceFinding.summary, never a structured field - confirmed no re-classification was attempted; the taxonomy is presented exactly as the Sermon engine already wrote it.

designDecision: harvest_sermon(conn, findings, sermon) is a pure aggregation function with no detection logic of its own: it does not classify text, does not invent a title/summary when one is absent, and runs no new pass over the transcript. Elements are filtered to domain==Sermon && sermon_id==Some(sermon.id) && status != Rejected (excludes operator-rejected findings but deliberately keeps Detected/Reviewed/Accepted - harvesting only Accepted would silently drop everything the operator hadn't reviewed yet). The Tauri command calls active_sermon_or_error (the same guard every other active-sermon-scoped command uses) and refuses cleanly for a past/restarted-session sermon rather than silently returning an incomplete elements: [] bundle.

filesChanged.apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/harvest.rs: New module - SermonHarvest struct, harvest_sermon() pure aggregation function, HARVEST_TRANSCRIPT_LIMIT/HARVEST_TIMELINE_LIMIT bounds (5,000 each, generous for a multi-hour service), 3 unit tests.
filesChanged.apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs: New harvest_sermon Tauri command - resolves the active sermon via active_sermon_or_error, calls harvest::harvest_sermon, records a SermonHarvested timeline entry, emits a SermonHarvested event.
filesChanged.apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs: Registered mod harvest; and commands::harvest_sermon in the invoke_handler.
filesChanged.apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/events.rs: New AppEvent::SermonHarvested variant, mapped to the SERMON_HARVESTED name.
filesChanged.apps/desktop/src/events/eventNames.ts: Added SermonHarvested: "SERMON_HARVESTED" to the AppEvents object mirroring the Rust enum.
filesChanged.apps/desktop/src/domain/sermon.ts: New SermonHarvest interface, importing from the ai/intelligence/live domain barrels.
filesChanged.apps/desktop/src/components/LiveChurchBr: New "Sermon Harvest" panel - a single button (disabled when no sermon is active) that fetches and displays the bundle in five collapsible <details> sections (Sections/Elements/Scripture/Transcript/Timeline).

scopeConfirmedNarrow: No new database migration, no new persistence, no new detection engine, no new dependency. Only a read-back aggregation of already-persisted/already-in-memory data plus one new event/command/UI panel following the exact record_timeline + emit convention every other explicit operator action in this codebase already uses.
